content:
BUILT CoLAB and 3drivers would like to invite you to participate in the Workshop “Guide to Carbon Handprint”. This event aims to frame the concept of Carbon Fingerprint and present the Methodological Guide that is being developed within the work of the FoC – Future of Construction project.

📅 Wednesday 13 July | ⏰10:00 📌 Online

Participation is free, but registration required 👉 here.

Agenda

Boas-Vindas e Apresentação do projeto FoC | Paulo Fonseca – BUILT CoLAB

Apresentação do Guia para Impressão Digital de Carbono | António Lorena – 3drivers

Apresentação dos resultados do inquérito sobre descarbonização do setor AEC | Ana Lopes – 3drivers

Apresentação de casos de estudo de empresas

    . Margarida Magina | Quadrante

    . Margarida Mateus | Secil

    . Cristina Maia | Casais

Aplicações práticas da Metodologia a partir de casos de estudo reais | Ana Lopes – 3drivers

Perguntas e Respostas | Paulo Fonseca – BUILT CoLAB

Encerramento | Paulo Fonseca – BUILT CoLAB

The results of the survey on decarbonisation of the AEC sector will also be presented and experiences/case studies of several AEC companies/organisations on the implementation of decarbonisation strategies will be shared.

More information at https://futureofconstruction.pt/.
